title: Two-sided inverse of a normalized affine degree comparison
statement: For affine étale objects U and W of X, g : W → U, quasi-coherent F on X and degree n, every morphism from the lifted Amitsur degree term to the lifted singleton tensor-section Čech degree term satisfying the pure-tensor normalization admits a categorical inverse on both sides.

proof.text: Apply the bijectivity intermediate to the underlying additive homomorphism, form its AddEquiv inverse, and package that inverse as an AddCommGrpCat morphism; the two categorical identities follow by extensionality and the AddEquiv inverse laws.

theorem exists_singletonTensorDegreeComparison_inverse
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (hU : IsAffine U.left) (hW : IsAffine W.left)
    (n : ℕ)
    (f : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ⟶
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n)
    (hf : IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom X F U W g n f) :
    ∃ inv : (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n ⟶
      (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n,
      f ≫ inv = 𝟙 _ ∧ inv ≫ f = 𝟙 _
